description: pururin.me gallery page (/gallery/<id>/<slug>) as served before Vue mounts (Laravel/Bootstrap 4 layout, server-rendered table, Vue components such as <gallery-rating>/<gallery-favorite> left as unknown tags). Info block: div.gallery-wrapper[itemscope itemtype=schema.org/Book] with div.cover-wrapper img[itemprop=image] (same URL as og:image) and an <h1><span itemprop=name> bilingual heading 'English / 日本語' (title is the first half), then table.table-gallery-info whose first cell is the bare row label: Artist, Circle, Parody, Contents, Character, Category, Language, Scanlator, Convention, Pages ('26 (16.42 MB)' — the size must not be read as a count), Uploader, Uploaded ('September 14, 2024', plain text), Ratings (AggregateRating microdata). Entity links go to /browse/tags/<kind>/<n>/<slug> with kinds artist/circle/parody/content/character/category/language/scanlator/convention; each link's title attribute is bilingual ('Quill Ninc / サンプルハオイサ/サンプルハオイサ') — the parody itself contains a slash, so splitting on '/' instead of ' / ' breaks it. Below the table an 'Edit Tags' modal repeats every list as JSON in hidden inputs (artist_tags, circle_tags, parody_tags, contents_tags, character_tags, scanlator_tags, convention_tags, collection_tags) with the same values. Noise: navbar Tags dropdown (/tags/<kind> index pages), a Category dropdown of format words and a Language dropdown, both linking /browse/tags/category|language/...; breadcrumb with 'Doujinshi'; 6 lazy preview thumbnails (loading.gif src, data-src .../86334/<n>t.jpg); a Related Galleries grid of 6 cards with protocol-relative lazy covers (//cdn.pururin.me/.../<id>/cover.jpg) and their own artist/circle/parody/character/content links (one card is by the same artist about Quill Kedo); comments linking another artist and writing fake row labels ('Character: PenWgbl', 'Tags: netorare', 'Uploaded:'); a footer 'Popular Contents' list of /browse/tags/content links; the scanlator 'Quill Zqxz', the convention 'Comic Market 104' and the uploader 'penpubf' are not artists/groups/tags. Unsure of: pururin.me's current class names (gallery-wrapper, cover-wrapper, box-gallery, tag-link, card-gallery, card-tags), whether the table cells wrap links in ul.list-inline, whether link titles carry the Japanese half, the exact Uploaded format (it may be relative or carry a datetime attribute), whether the edit-tags hidden inputs sit in a modal or beside the table, whether related cards list artist/tag links at all, whether comments are server-rendered, and the footer tag list; the gallery, names and ids are invented.
